name: 案件単位のデータベース見出し
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: LH09-0043 Japanese database project group header.
Create only the compact horizontal group-header component on pure white canvas. Image2 ORIGINAL crop is primary authority for icon shape, stroke/optical weight, proportions, fine details and spacing, image1 original full screen supplies context. Image3 mock is SECONDARY Japanese wording/layout guide; do not copy its diamond replacement or spread the menu controls far away.
Content exactly: a small downward filled disclosure triangle; a fine circled right-pointing arrow relation glyph; underlined Japanese group title「礼拝の準備」; muted count「2」; horizontal three-dot menu; thin plus. Preserve this order, compact left-aligned grouping and all six elements. Circle arrow matches original shape, adapted forest green #1F6444 as meaningful project section marker. Other utility icons slate #526173; count neutral gray; title ink #1D1D1D, Meiryo Regular 14/24, zero tracking, NOT bold. Count Meiryo Regular 12/16.
Official Lighthouse design: pure white page/canvas; quiet readable compact composition, no extra card/container, no broad mint fill, no decorative accents, no new copy or control. No row data or full page. Sharp flat UI export; keep thin strokes. Preserve established typography roles; actual output is a candidate.
reviewNotes: Original triangle/circled arrow/underline/count2/ellipsis/plus restored and Japanese title visually checked. Forest-green project marker and slate controls; white canvas. Export scale/outer margin differs; exact font/vector identity and behavior unproved.
